messages:
🎉 Barcelona · Sun 22 Nov
Yellow wind alert until this evening, so check outdoor plans. No Argentine nights or tardeos confirmed for today or tomorrow; Los Fabulosos Cadillacs play Sant Jordi Club on Fri 27.

TODAY · Sun 22 Nov

1. RHAPSODIA 3: FRANGLISH x TEKNO x YAPI.
🕘 Today 17:00 → 23:00 · 📍 SALA APOLO
📊 no public headcount (DICE doesn't publish one)
💶 €49.58
💬 Afrobeats day party with Franglish and Tekno live, moved to Apolo because it outgrew the first venue; the promoter says nearly sold out. Expect a full main room, around a thousand, so buy before you go.
https://dice.fm/event/99e2m7-rhapsodia-3-franglish-x-tekno-x-yapi-22nd-nov-sala-apolo-barcelona-tickets

2. Tapantoni — Sant Antoni tapas route
🕘 Sun 22 Nov, hours not stated · 📍 Bars across the Sant Antoni neighbourhood
📊 1,371 likes on @planesenbarcelona's weekend round-up
💶 Tapa + drink €3.80
💬 You hop between neighbourhood bars, each doing one tapa and a drink for a fixed price. A plan for friends you already have, not for meeting people. Bars are busy but spread out; I could not confirm this year's hours.
https://www.instagram.com/p/Df4_g09jU8J/

3. Fira de Nadal de la Sagrada Família
🕘 Sun 22 Nov, hours not stated · 📍 Plaça de la Sagrada Família
📊 1,668 likes on @ordatwins' post
💶 Free entry
💬 The city's traditional Christmas market, opened yesterday: stalls of decorations, trees and food under the basilica. A stroll with friends, an hour at most. First weekend, so expect thousands passing through.
https://www.instagram.com/p/DgApJqrNxGh/

4. Electrostad: FREE PARTY with INOFF B2B Victor Hugo, LOW FUNDS
🕘 Tonight 23:59 → 05:00 · 📍 Sidecar
📊 209 interested on RA · also on Eventbrite
💶 Free
💬 Free weekly house and electronica night run by local DJs in a small basement club off Plaça Reial. The RA interest is high for a free Sunday, so expect the room full, a couple of hundred.
https://ra.co/events/2549261

5. Temples + Miel
🕘 Tonight 20:00 → 23:30 · 📍 PARAL·LEL 62
📊 no public headcount (DICE doesn't publish one)
💶 €30.86
💬 British psych-rock band Temples in a 900-capacity hall. No headcount published; the forecast rests on the venue size and a touring band with a following, so likely several hundred.
https://dice.fm/event/l8dwyx-temples-miel-22nd-nov-parallel-62-barcelona-tickets

TOMORROW · Mon 23 Nov

1. Christmas videomapping at Plaça de Sant Jaume
🕘 Mon 18:30 → 22:00 · 📍 Plaça de Sant Jaume
📊 398 likes on @barcelonasecreta's guide
💶 Free
💬 Light projections on the City Hall and Generalitat facades, with music at 18:30, 19:30 and 20:30. You stand in the square and watch for 15 minutes; a stop with friends before dinner in the Gòtic. Hundreds per session.
https://www.instagram.com/p/DgCcS2yDEqK/

2. Els Llums de Sant Pau — Little Prince light trail
🕘 Mon, entry from about 17:30 to 20:30 · 📍 Recinte Modernista de Sant Pau
📊 4,674 likes on @ordatwins' post
💶 About €10–20 depending on the day
💬 A ticketed walk through the lit-up modernist hospital gardens, about an hour. Go with friends or a date; you will not meet anyone. Two city guides covered it; check Monday slots on the website before going.
https://www.instagram.com/p/DgAOdRYtvLo/

3. BEACH 5K #80: Run, Connect & Win! With BCN Entrepreneurs & Professionals
🕘 Mon 19:00 → 21:00 · 📍 La Carioca
📊 18 going on Meetup · group has 529 members
💶 Free to RSVP
💬 5K along the beach with founders and remote workers, then drinks. Two groups list the same run, so expect 30 to 40 people; small, but the easiest place on a Monday to meet people in tech.
https://www.meetup.com/bcnglobals/events/317204894/

4. Piñata presenta: Infinity Song
🕘 Mon 19:30 → 22:45 · 📍 SALA APOLO
📊 no public headcount (DICE doesn't publish one)
💶 €27.70
💬 New York sibling soft-rock band known for their harmonies, at Apolo. No headcount published; going by the venue and their online following, expect a few hundred rather than a packed house.
https://dice.fm/event/92rg66-piata-presenta-infinity-song-23rd-nov-sala-apolo-barcelona-tickets

Scanned: Meetup 198 · RA 22 · DICE 7 · Xceed 8 · Eventbrite 124 · Luma 5 · Instagram 24 posts + 8 stories.
